caseName: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission v. Jersey Central Power & Light Co.
caseNameFull: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission v. Jersey Central Power & Light Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Franks v. Bowman Transportation Co., Inc., 424 U. S. 747.

Mr. Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
